INSERT INTO dataset_members
           (dataset_id, session_id, participant_pseudonym, age_months, age_band, split, label)
         SELECT $1, s, p, a, b, sp, l::jsonb
         FROM unnest($2::text[], $3::text[], $4::int4[], $5::text[], $6::text[], $7::text[])
              AS u(s, p, a, b, sp, l)
